title: Equality, diversity and accessible information
summary: Whether every person gets fair care and information they can understand, including the Accessible Information Standard.
whenToUse: Every year, or when the service supports people with new communication, language or cultural needs.

statements.focus: Accessible Information Standard: communication needs asked about, recorded, flagged and met.
Nobody is turned away or gets less because of a protected characteristic or language.
Outcomes and feedback compared across different groups of people.
Culture, religion, gender and sexuality respected in how care is given.
Fair treatment of staff and support for staff from all backgrounds.
